```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin {component: 'qtype_ddmarker'})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Plugin)
WHERE dependency.last_release_ts IS NOT NULL AND dependency.last_release_ts < (datetime({year: 2026, month: 9, day: 10}).epochSeconds - (3 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60))
RETURN dependency.component, dependency.name, dependency.last_release_ts
ORDER BY dependency.last_release_ts ASC
LIMIT 100
```
